tools.name: listing_search
tools.description: Search for IKEA products and content. Use a short product family or category term only, such as 'kallax' rather than 'kallax black-brown'. Keep colour, size, finish, price, and other attributes for filters. Search broadly first, then use listing_list_filters to understand available dimensions and narrow the results.

query.description: A short product family, category, or content term. Do not include attributes such as colour or size; for example, use 'kallax' instead of 'kallax black-brown'.
